| description = Sand [[giant]]s are among the cursed remnants of Rallos' great army who wander the Deserts of Ro. They are uncommon sights but very dangerous to newbies who hunt gators and orcs in the [[Oasis of Marr]]. Higher level players who can defeat them will be rewarded with substantial platinum.

=== Spawn Locations ===

In the [[Northern Desert of Ro]] there is one Sand Giant that spawns at (-152, 366). This is just South West of the big Dervish Cutthroat (Derv 2) camp. It spawns every 6:30 with [[A Desert Madman]] or [[A Madman]] roughly 50% of the time as a place holder. After spawning, it wanders off to the south and roams about. 

[[Southern Desert of Ro]]. Sand Giant Popped 6pm Game time between Evil Merchants and Dervish Cutthroat camp in the northwest after a rain and Unknown PHs eliminated. Would Like to know if sand giant is PH for SG Husam in South Ro... 

The [[Oasis of Marr]] probably has the most SG spawn points. It's possible to see more several up and wandering at the same time between the sro zoneline and the lake, scarabs seem to be likely PHs there. At least a couple also spawn in the northern stretches of the zone. One Oasis spawn point is 979, 668 on a 6 min 40 second timer spawns either a giant or desert madman.
A another spawns at 1027.64, 434.74 sharing  a spawn point with a ghoul PH.
